Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 5 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 19 done? What have you finished, what’s next, are you blocked, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: Yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and you have nothing blocking you.

task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being blocked until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, is story 5 done, is bug 12 done, and is story 2 done?
What have you finished, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I’ll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for your blocker on bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment: The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today., and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is task 14 done after you said you’d finish it tomorrow, and is story 1 done after you planned to keep working on it?
What have you finished, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the task delayed because the sandbox was down, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker and commitment, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Quick recap: we heard progress across payment status, settlement validation, retry work, and PCI exceptions, and blockers were raised around bug 12 sandbox gateway timeouts, security review dependencies, and sandbox availability. The side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration is parked for offline follow-up. One item was not covered: task 15 (stale), and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
